## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and owned module.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. State unavailable checks and absent tests.

## Collaboration

- [ ] Scope respects module ownership; necessary shared changes are coordinated in a reviewed integration change.
- [ ] Updated the branch by fetching and merging `origin/main`; resolved conflicts deliberately.
- [ ] No credentials, unrelated reformatting, manually edited lockfiles/snapshots, or uncoordinated shared database changes.
- [ ] Relevant personal documentation and AI usage log updated, if applicable.
